text:
Alice Nguyen: Hi folks — I pushed a follow-up to PR #4532 that squashes the retry helpers into a single small module and fixes the edge-case that caused duplicate state in the allocator. PTAL when you have a minute, I force-pushed the branch (0b3f2a -> 0b4d9c). Need one approver for a canary tonight if everything looks good. CC @Ben @Carol
Ben O'Connor: thanks — will take a look in ~30m. do you have a short repro for the flake you mentioned?
Alice Nguyen: the flaky test I saw was `tests/integration/test-retry-loop.py::test-backoff` — it's timing-sensitive. I added a deterministic mock for time in the latest commit, and added the extra assertion that was missing. locally `pytest -q tests/integration/test-retry-loop.py` passes for me.
Carol Li: i can do a quick smoke run after lunch. can you paste the exact smoke steps so i don't miss anything? :+1:
Alice Nguyen: sure — quick smoke:```bash
# from repo root
git fetch origin && git checkout pr/4532
make build-image
docker-compose -f docker/dev-compose.yml up -d \
# run a small request against the runtime
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":8}'
```should be fast (3-4s) if kv cache path is fine. also look at logs `docker-compose logs -f runtime` for errors.
Samira Patel: CI looks green now (retriggered flaky job). CI-Bot shows `build: passed` on the latest commit. can we get someone to lgtm so we can reserve a canary slot?
CI-Bot: build passed — all checks OK for commit 0b4d9c
Ben O'Connor: gave it a skim — code looks good, tests cover the case, small nit inline but not blocking. leaving a :+1: once the nit is addressed.
Alice Nguyen: thanks, ben — nit was wording in the test assertion, pushed fixup (0b4d9c -> 0b4f1aa). no functional change.
Carol Li: ran the smoke steps, exercise request returned 200 and logs looked clean. one minor log line still noisy but unrelated. LGTM from me. :shipit:
Alice Nguyen: awesome — thanks Carol. @Samira can you grab the 21:00 UTC canary slot?
deploy-bot: Canary slot requested for PR #4532 by Alice Nguyen — provisional slot 21:00 UTC. Please confirm runway and any blocking migrations.
Samira Patel: reserving 21:00 UTC now. I'll watch the canary and rollback if latency regresses.
Alice Nguyen: perfect. if anyone wants to flip through the small nit i left, feel free, otherwise i'll merge after the slot is locked. thanks all! :tada:
